_comment: Titles for maps the game's map master leaves untitled (map.txt map_title None, floor 0), by map id; resolved by src/core/field/map_names.cpp override_title: a string is a game message key; {"text": mod text key}; {"owner": baked NPC name} = N's House; {"room": baked NPC name} = N's Room; {"entity": baked object name} = that object's translated name; {"item": item message} = I Room; a list joins its parts. Labels inferred from the baked contents under the user's rules of 2026-10-11 (a named NPC's house, a generic NPC's House, else the defining event or point, else nothing); castle, airship, dungeon and cutscene rooms stay unlabelled. Evidence per entry: docs/MAP_LABELS.md.
